articleTitle: Research on Air Quality Prediction Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In recent years, the prevention and control of environmental pollution attracted much attention, and the haze weather directly affects people's travel health. In order to effectively prevent and control air pollution, optimize the air quality evaluation system. In this paper, PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf>, PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf>, SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, CO and O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>_8h are used as characteristic factors, and air quality index is used as a decision factor. A variety of regression algorithms are selected to establish a prediction model, and the accuracy and generalization ability of various algorithms are compared. The results show that the Random Forest Regression algorithm (RFR) and the Gradient Boosting Regression algorithm (GBR) can effectively predict the Air Quality Index (AQI) and the air quality level. This paper provides a reference for the establishment of the air quality model.

articleTitle: Face Shape Classification Based on MTCNN and FaceNet
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Deep learning has made great progress in the field of face recognition. Most face shape classification methods use the distance and Angle between facial features and the landmarks of facial outline, and calculate some values through formulas. With the development of deep learning, many methods take face shape as the learning object. After comparing some networks, this paper uses MTCNN and FaceNet, and the accuracy is 92.32%, which is higher than other networks. In addition, Center Loss is used instead of Triplet Loss to achieve a better effect.

articleTitle: Modelling and Simulation of Direct Drive Permanent Magnet Wind Power Generation System Based on Simulink
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Wind power generation has the advantages of high conversion efficiency, high reliability, and flexible control. The widely used grid-connected wind power generation system is mostly adopted asynchronous generator, which has low efficiency. Therefore, A direct-wind power generation system based on a permanent magnet synchronous generator is proposed in this paper. By studying the characteristics and operation mechanism of wind turbines and permanent magnet generators, wind speed, wind turbine, permanent magnet synchronous generator, and direct-drive wind power control system models are established. Aiming at the characteristics of low conversion efficiency and low reliability of traditional wind power systems, a vector control method for the generator side converter based on the rotor magnetic field orientation is proposed in this paper, which achieves the maximum wind energy capture and greatly improves the efficiency of the generator. Finally, the direct-drive wind power system was built by Matlab simulation, which verified whether the system could stably capture wind energy and output energy to the maximum extent under the condition of wind speed change.

articleTitle: Generating Anime Characters and Experimental Analysis Based on DCGAN Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Animation culture in the 20th century has long been free from paper cartoons. From the beginning, when painters drew comics characters with a pen, people can now use a computer to generate anime characters. As with most forms of art, anime characters are designed and created by the artist himself, but if the production of anime characters is automated using the Generative Adversarial Network (GAN), will different forms of anime characters be ended up? Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) is a deep learning model and one of the most promising methods for unsupervised learning on complex distributions in recent years. The model produces quite good output through mutual game learning of (at least) two modules in the framework: Generative (G) Model and Discriminative (D) Model. The generator is a network that generates images and the Discriminator is a network that identifies as evaluating whether an image is “real” or not. For instance, the generative model gives a series of pictures of dogs and then generates a new picture of a dog that is not in the data set. The discriminant model gives a picture and then judges whether the animal in this picture is a cat or a dog. This paper will also use DCGAN. DCGAN is not only related to GAN but also related to CNN. Both the discriminator and generator of Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Networks (DCGAN) use Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to replace the multilayer perceptron in GAN. DCGAN, as the name implies, a GAN is added to the deep convolution. It mainly constitutes a convolution layer with no maximum pooling or full connection layer. It uses the convergence of Convolutional stride and transpose for downsampling and upsampling.

articleTitle: Two-stage insulator self-explosion defect detection method based on Mask R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: With the continuous development of power systems, the application of UAVs in the inspection of power systems has become more and more extensive. Aiming at the problem of few defect insulator samples and complex background, a detection method of Two-stage insulator self-explosion defect detection method based on Mask R-CNN is proposed. This paper uses Mask R-CNN to obtain the mask of the insulator and the corresponding original image part, and send them into the classification model with SPP network. The final insulator detection accuracy reached 87.5%.

articleTitle: Research on Trash Classification based on Artificial Intelligence and Sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: This topic combines artificial intelligence technology and sensor technology to design intelligent trash cans in application to the environmental protection classification system. In this system, the CNN network is used to recognize faces, YOLOv3 is used to recognize objects, and sensor technology is used to sense the human body temperature and to monitor the capacity of the trash can for switch control of its cover. In this case, there would be complete zero contact during the whole trash dumping process and it is instrumental in avoiding the spread of the epidemic. This topic provides a new method and genuine case for intelligent environmental protection.

articleTitle: Prediction of PM2.5 concentration in Guangzhou based on LSTM neural network
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Accurate prediction of PM2.5 concentration can effectively avoid the harm of heavy pollution weather to the human body. The change of PM2.5 concentration results from many factors, and the process is sudden, nonlinear, with evident uncertainty, it is difficult to predict by traditional methods. A PM2.5 prediction model based on long-term and short-term memory neural network was designed by deep learning method to solve this problem. Combined with multiple meteorological, weather, and air pollution index data of PM2.5 in Guangzhou, the long-term and short-term memory network (LSTM) neural network and recurrent neural network (RNN) were used to test the prediction effect. The results show that the LSTM model has a better prediction effect than the RNN model.

articleTitle: Research on the Usability Evaluation Model of Human-Computer Interaction for Command and Control System
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In view of the present problems encountered in the command and control system, such as lack of scientific and complete indicator system for the human-computer interactive usability, absence of the relevant evaluation model, deficiency of quantitative method of results evaluation, and unavailable comprehensive and quantitative evaluation of the results from tested system, this work analyzed the influence elements of human-computer interaction for command and control system, to build the hierarchical evaluation indices systematically. Ausability evaluation model of human-computer interaction is proposed, which can be used to find the problems of unsafety and inefficiency existing in human-computer interaction of command and control system. Iterative optimization in the procedure of system development is carried out, in order to improve the human-computer interaction of command and control system.

articleTitle: Window Adaptive Backoff Algorithm Basing on Statistical Priority-based Multiple Access Protocol
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Statistical priority-based Multiple Access protocol (SPMA) is the latest MAC layer protocol in high speed aviation network technology, which can be applied to high speed aviation mobile network well. In this paper, We proposed an improved backoff algorithm based on SPMA protocol, which changes the competition interval of SPMA backoff algorithm from fixed to dynamic adjustment. In this paper, we derive the network delay using the improved algorithm. Finally, we conduct simulation verification in Opnet. The results show that the improved algorithm has excellent performance in high, medium and low traffic load, especially in high traffic load, ensuring the successful transmission rate of data frames with the highest priority.

articleTitle: Construction and Research of Regional Green Finance Statistical Model Based on CVM-MLP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Green finance is the only way for China to change its economic development model, but China's green finance is in the development stage, the green financial market is not perfect, and it is complicated to collect and predict large-scale green financial data. This paper constructs regional green financial, statistical system, and green financial index by CVM (coefficient of variation method) algorithm, then constructs MLP (multi-layer perceptron) neural network and predicts green financial data by analyzing MLP. The results show that “Nature Conservation, Ecological Restoration and Disaster Prevention and Control Project”, “Green Forestry Development Project” and “Building Energy Saving and Green Building” are more important through the example construction and research of green finance statistical model in Gansu Province, China. This algorithm is beneficial to optimize the resource allocation of the financial system, improve the efficiency of value discovery of the financial system, and have broad application prospects in the direction of green financial forecasting.

articleTitle: Data-driven adaptive improved just-in-time learning for industrial process soft sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In the industrial process, data-driven soft sensor technology can obtain the information of key variables in real time. However, real industrial processes often show multimodal characteristics due to the influence of switching conditions. The traditional methods are all aimed at single-modal data modeling. Applying these methods directly to multi-modal data will result in a decrease in model accuracy. In this paper, improved just-in-time learning for the soft sensor is proposed to deal with multimodal characteristics. First, we select similar samples as training data sets from the historical database based on the new sample. Then, a neighbor similarity coefficient is designed to judge the similarity between samples, determining the number of samples in the training set adaptively. Finally, a partial least squares (PLS) model is established based on the selected training set data, which is used to measure the key variables for the new sample. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by an industrial example.

articleTitle: Detection and Recognition of Traffic Lights in Complex Environment in Unmanned System
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: With the development of the social economy and the progress of science and technology, cars have been gradually popularized in life, traffic congestion, frequent accidents and other phenomena are increasing, traffic safety and road traffic efficiency and other problems has become more and more serious, and become the focus of attention. In this context, the safety of driverless smart cars has become one of the key technologies and difficulties. The research of traffic signal detection and recognition algorithm based on computer vision has become an important research field of intelligent traffic, including two modules: signal light detection and recognition. Although there are many detection and recognition algorithms at home and abroad, due to the variability of the color and environmental light of the signal light itself, the complex environment, and the real-time requirements of the traffic intersection, the existing algorithms will have some limitations in their application. They can't handle the above problems well. In this paper, the widely used circular and arrowhead traffic lights are detected and identified.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis Anime Character Generation Based on DCGAN Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Today's widespread animation culture and growing interest of the public have contributed to the development of a variety of animation works and characters. However, in many cases, the artists have to invest a lot of time into the idea of the task to be able to deliver their work; and dealing with such a task, obviously, is a huge consumption of time and energy. Accordingly, in many cases, these artists may not have enough inspiration to create a unique character. To tackle this issue, this paper proposed a generative network, which can be utilized to randomly generate unique anime characters. The application of the whole model is divided into three steps. First, a program is adopted for face recognition and interception of the data collected on the network. From the program and the data collected, over 50,000 photos were collected that were different and contained only the faces of the characters; second, the random generation model of this DCGAN was trained for more than a week, and paused after achieving satisfactory results; third, this model can be used to randomly generate characters and output them as images. Finally, an elaborate model can be used to generate images with regular features, distinct characteristics, and similar style as the real works. In addition, a GUI was designed to help users select their favorite randomly generated photos and save them uniformly in a specified path. The created images can be used as design inspiration for the artists who lack the time to create their new inspirations.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of traditional kite art platform based on human-computer interaction and WebAR technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet and the update and iteration of electronic products, augmented reality technology is widely used in military, medical, education, entertainment and other fields. Compared with traditional AR technology, WebAR can efficiently run on the web browsers of various systems and can be used without additional APP. WebAR achieves the advantages of a light-weight, easy spread and cross-platform. With the development of these digital means, the way of human-computer interaction presentation is also changing with each passing day. It is gradually being loved and sought after by people. In this paper, we propose a traditional kite art platform based on human-computer interaction and WebAR technology, focusing on the types and crafts of kites. Through the use of front-end, three-dimensional (3D) modeling and other technologies on the platform, users can better experience the charm of traditional kite art.

articleTitle: Analysis of Emoji Generation Based on DCGAN Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Deep Convolution Generative Adversarial Networks consist of a generative neural network and a discriminative neural network. The generator's objective is to learn the features of existing images and output fake samples that imitate the training data. At the same time, the discriminator attempts to discriminate the generated images from the real training data. However, the training process of the model is unstable due to the simultaneous training of two adversarial networks: the modification of one network means changing the entire model. To further understand this issue, this paper constructed a DCGAN model, which can be utilized to generate fake cartoon emojis. This paper proposed a generative neural network which generates image samples from a random input. The output of the generator and the training data, in this case the emoji images, are then given to a discriminative neural network which classifies its input as fake or real. The loss of the discriminator is then calculated based on its precision, while the loss of the generator is calculated based on the output of the discriminator. If the discriminator correctly recognizes the generated images as fake, then the loss of the generator is high; otherwise, the loss of the generator is low. The process of backpropagation updates the parameters in the discriminator and the generator using gradient descent, improving their outputs and minimizing their loss functions. As for the results, the model successfully learned the crucial features of the training data and converted the random noise to emoji images.

articleTitle: Cross-subject Error-related EEG Signal Detection Based on Riemannian Manifold and Filter Bank
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Brain-computer interface (BCI) attracted more and more attention in the past decade, and research about EEG signal has increased gradually. However, due to the large variability and volatility of different subjects EEG signals, cross-subject models often perform poorly. This paper proposes a method to identify error-related potential (ERRP) P300 signals which come from public dataset. First, using the XDAWN algorithm to estimate the average evoked potentials and add them to the original signals. By this way, making the Riemannian mean of difference classes farther. Second, selecting electrode channels based on the Riemannian distance of Riemannian mean, reducing convergence time effectively. Third, extracting Riemannian features based on Riemannian kernel. Finally, combining multi-band features and projecting features of different domains into the common feature space, and then detecting by a suitable way. The method proposed in this experiment will be compared with the other methods. And we will analyze the results to prove the effectiveness in the situation that uses a single subject as the target domain.

articleTitle: Research on Human Eye Detection Enhancement Based on Homomorphic Filtering
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: This paper introduces the methods of human eye detection under normal light source and infrared light source respectively, and puts forward the research of human eye detection image enhancement. During image preprocessing, the color image is transformed into gray image, and then the gray level probability distribution of gray image histogram is transformed into uniform gray level probability through histogram equalization, so as to improve the contrast of gray image and the accuracy of human eye detection. Homomorphic filtering image processing method developed on the basis of Retinex theory is used for image enhancement of human eye detection. Comparing the image enhancement effects of the two methods, it is concluded that after homomorphic filtering is used to filter and enhance the human eye image, the human eye contrast effect of the image is relatively more obvious and the image is clearer.

articleTitle: Research on Ant Colony Algorithm for Wing Assembly Sequence Planning
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Aiming at the assembly sequence planning problem of mechanical products, an assembly sequence planning method based on ant colony algorithm is proposed. The algorithm model is established by fully studying the geometric constraints in the assembly process combined with ant colony algorithm. In the process of ant colony optimization, parts screening rules are added to assist the ant colony to select the optimal solution, and the optimal assembly sequence is finally obtained. Taking the aircraft wing model as an example, the feasibility and accuracy of the algorithm model are verified.

articleTitle: Research on the Technology of Generating Single-Table sql Query Sentences in Chinese Natural Language
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet nowadays, the amount of data has become larger and larger. It is easier to save data in the database, but finding the information people want from the database has become an urgent problem. The main task of the natural language generating SQL query statement task is to convert the natural language into an executable SQL query statement. However, how to convert natural language into SQL queries has become a difficult task for this task. This research mainly uses the template-filled SQLNet model as the benchmark model to design a model from Chinese natural language to SQL query statements. At the same time, two modules, select num and where relation, are added to the Select clause and the where clause, respectively. At the same time, modify the condition value module in the where clause and then predict the condition value after adding the column type information. This Chinese NL2SQL deep learning model was experimentally verified on an open Chinese data set TableQA. The experimental results show that the model can effectively convert Chinese natural language into SQL query sentences.

articleTitle: The chaotic time series prediction method based on sparrow search algorithm optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: With the maturity of chaos theory and the rapid development of artificial intelligence, the establishment of chaotic time series prediction model based on neural network has become a hot issue. In order to further improve the prediction accuracy of neural network and solve the shortcomings of traditional BP neural network in convergence speed and stability, the chaotic time series prediction method based on the optimization of sparrow algorithm is proposed. The threshold and weight of neural network topology are optimized by using a new Sparrow Search Algorithm to improve the robustness of network prediction, so as to solve the prediction problem of chaotic time series. The experimental results show that the proposed optimization method has been significantly improved in prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Non-intrusive major industrial equipment monitoring based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM) technology can obtain the information of electricity consumption of each equipment by only analyzing the aggregated data of electricity meter and. In this paper, non-intrusive monitoring of the major industrial equipment is studied based on on-site energy consumption data of a factory. The deep learning methods are used for industrial load decomposition to monitor the operation status of critical production equipment around the clock. The testing results prove the validity of the method for industrial load decomposition to some extent.

articleTitle: Research on the posture recognition method of suckling sow based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: The posture of the sow is one of the important evaluation indicators of its maternal behavior, so it has received extensive attention from breeding and breeding management. At present, the recognition of the sow's posture is mostly based on machine vision and three-axis acceleration sensors. However, when using machine vision technology to capture individual posture images of pigs in the rearing state, the efficiency of sow posture recognition is low due to factors such as light intensity, complexity of the environment in the pen, and location of the pigs. In this paper, 18 postpartum Dumin (Dulac × Min pigs) sow postures were collected for 8 days of video data, and the sow posture recognition model was established based on the Dual-Resnet34 method. Offline and online data enhancement methods are used to enhance the captured image and efficiently decouple the posture features to improve the efficiency of model training. A dual-channel residual network combined with a large convolution kernel is proposed to linearly determine the pig features, which improves the accuracy of the model. The results show that the model proposed in this paper has a positive rate of 99.68%, 99.99%, 99.06%,99.5%, and 99.99% for the 5 types of postures of lactating sows on the test set. And the overall recognition rate of various gestures of pigs reaches 99.5%, which is an increase of 0.42% compared to the single-channel Resnet34. Therefore, this method improves the recognition accuracy while ensuring the recognition efficiency, which can provide a technical reference for the automatic recognition of sow behavior.

articleTitle: Processing Technology of Multi-sensor Position Fingerprint Information
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Aiming at the poor stability of the fingerprint library constructed using single sensor location fingerprint information and low positioning accuracy due to insufficient depth of fingerprint feature mining in traditional location fingerprint information processing technology, a new multi-sensor location fingerprint processing technology is proposed. First, the CSI phase and amplitude of the WiFi signal, the RSS of the 4G cellular network and the geomagnetic information are used as the joint location fingerprint information. Then, the convolutional neural network is used to further process the location fingerprint. Experiments show that the proposed method is superior to the commonly used neural network methods in terms of positioning accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Feature Processing of Multi-classification Motor Imagery EEG based on improved ICA and SVM
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In order to increase the recognition accuracy of multiple motor imagery EEG (MIEEG) signals in Brain Computer Interface (BCI), this paper presents a novel idea for motor imagery recognition based on improved Independent Component Analysis (ICA) and a multi-class Support Vector Machine (SVM) model. After the original EEG signal is preprocessed, an effective filter is designed by improved ICA algorithm to automatically extract the independent components related to motor imagery, and then the independent components are optimized to construct the EEG feature set, which is input into the SVM classifier finally. Our work is tested on BCI III contest data set and self-collected data set, the experimental results show good recognition accuracy and strong robustness, which proves our method is appropriate for EEG processing.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent Terminal authentication Strategy based on block chain
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In the face of huge Internet of Things (IoT) application scenarios, although trusted access and management of IoT devices can be realized through a single blockchain, there are problems of increased time consumption and low throughput. To solve the above problems, this paper proposes an IoT device authentication strategy based on master-slave chain structure. Firstly, the master-slave chain network structure of IoT device authentication is proposed based on blockchain technology. Secondly, the reputation evaluation mechanism is introduced to estimate the reputation value of slave chain nodes and IoT devices, so as to provide basis for the selection of consensus nodes. Thirdly, by selecting the consensus node with high reputation value and optimizing the consensus stage, the Practical Byzantine Fault Tolerance (PBFT) consensus algorithm is improved to increase the consensus throughput and improve the consensus efficiency of the authentication process. Finally, the authentication smart contract is designed to ensure fair and credible implementation of authentication rules. Security analysis shows that these strategies have high security against mainstream IoT attacks, reduce the delay of authentication request, and improve the efficiency and stability of authentication.

articleTitle: Network abnormal traffic detection method based on multi kernel KPCA-PSO-ELM
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In order to improve the detection rate of network abnormal traffic and reduce the false alarm rate, a network abnormal traffic detection method based on multi-core kpca-pso-elm is proposed. Firstly, Gauss radial basis function and d-order polynomial kernel function are mixed into multi-core kernel function, which has the generalization ability and learning ability of global and local kernel functions at the same time, so as to improve the efficiency of anomaly detection; Then, particle swarm optimization (PSO) is used to optimize the initial parameters of extreme learning machine (ELM), obtain the optimal solution of the parameters, reduce the influence of blindness in the process of random selection of parameters on the detection performance of limit learning machine, and improve the accuracy of anomaly detection. Finally, the optimized elm model is used to detect and classify the data. In order to verify the effectiveness of this algorithm, MATLAB and KDDCUP99 data set are used for experimental verification. The experimental results show that the detection effect of multi-core kpca-pso-elm model is significantly improved compared with PSO-SVM and PCA-BiGAN, and effectively improves the detection efficiency of network abnormal traffic detection.

articleTitle: Potential Practical Applications of Basic Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: 3D construction methods are usually based on expensive furniture using Light Detection and Ranging (LIDAR). Therefore, some people interested in this region are unable to put a practice on construction. Fortunately, some neural networks designed for image processing are ideal tools to balance the cost and gain. Combining a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) with a generative neural network (GAN) provides 3D constructionlovers an easy way to start. The two essential steps, cut images and construct models, use an independent network to provide the best result. To have a numerical understanding of the difference between our constructed model and ground truth, we also introduced the Hausdorff Distance to evaluate the model performance.

articleTitle: Research on State Modeling of Multiple Parsers Based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Transition-based dependency parsing is a fast and effective approach for dependency parsing. When the sentence is input to the transition-based dependency parser, the parser predicts a series of parsing actions from left to right. Stack information, which plays an essential role in the parsing process. In this paper, we propose a dependency parser that is based on bidirectional-LSTMs and an approach that uses the attention mechanism for learning representations of parser states. This model simulates the global state of the parser by capturing more relevant information, we dig into the stack information, buffer information, the word information that has been parsed out of the stack, the complete historical information of the actions taken by the parser, and semantic information during the parsing process. The words popped from the stack at each time step and the predicted action are then applied to the parsing task at the next time step, which is helpful to the parsing performance of the parser.

articleTitle: Distance Adaptive Embedding Learning for Social Network Alignment
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Aligning anchor users across multiple social networks has become an emerging task in recent years. Most of the existing methods align anchor users by leveraging network embedding techniques to learn a common embedding space of user nodes. However, nearly all these methods suffer from inappropriate structural proximity measurement and conflicting objectives, incurring inferior alignment results. In this paper, we propose a novel approach named Distance Adaptive Embedding Learning for Network Alignment (DAEL-NA) to tackle the above two issues. For the first issue, we measure structural proximity by Euclidean distance instead of the commonly used cosine similarity for user embedding learning. For the second issue, we propose the notion of Distance Adaptive Embedding Learning (DAEL) to discriminate an anchor user from its neighbors while preserving structural proximity. Experiments conducted over real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of DAEL-NA on social network alignment.

articleTitle: Subway Station Platform Crowd Density of Off-peak hours smart Monitoring on YOLOv3
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: The whole process of monitoring the crowd density of subway station based on YOLOv3 is proposed and implemented with some parameters adjusted as well as a new feature to identify crowd density added, which laids a foundation for intelligent dispersion and guidance of subway station pedestrain flow. Hundreds of picture samples are taken to train the network model. The results of cross validation shows that the rate of missed detection can be less than 10%, which preliminarily satisfies the precision requirements of operation.

articleTitle: Design of Automatic Speech Evaluation System of Professional English for the Navy based on Intelligent Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, the application scope of intelligent technology is increasingly expanding. Intelligent recognition technology has become a new trend in the reforming of foreign language teaching. This paper introduces the functional design and application of “Automatic Speech Evaluation System of Professional English for the Navy”. Through the analysis and comparison of the standard degree, correct degree and frequency of use of English pronunciation, the corresponding data results are output to promote the students' learning and mastering of practical English in the Navy and improve the learning effect.

Author Keywords: Automatic speech evaluation system Professional English for the Navy

articleTitle: Chinese Aviation Network Analysis under Actual Node Attack
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: During the Corona Virus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic, many airports were semi-closed to prevent the virus from spreading, which greatly impacted the Chinese aviation network. The current approach to the analysis of the Chinese aviation network completely removes nodes to study node attacks on the Chinese aviation network. However, it is not practical to close the airport completely while ignoring other airlines' adjustments. This paper investigates the changes of Chinese aviation networks under the real node attack and provides useful information and practical suggestions on how to deal with the transmission of infectious diseases by airlines in the future. First, we collect the flight schedules for representative dates from VariFlight, delete useless information, split layover flights and count the number of flights in each airport. Next, we compute the properties of the Chinese aviation network under node attacks such as betweenness centrality and PageRank. Finally, the properties are compared with those of normal dates to investigate the changes of the Chinese aviation network under node attack. The results indicate that the Chinese aviation network is a small-world and scale-free network. Our analyses demonstrate that the decline of airlines in hub airports can influence the properties of network and adjacent airports. Meanwhile, the node attack on a hub airport with many substitutes failed to achieve the expected result. Therefore, traffic restriction should also be applied to the substitutes if there are many large cities around the infectious city.

articleTitle: Computer Simulation Study of Underwater Blast Wave Loading of a Typical Combatant
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In order to study the forward shock wave load characteristics of underwater explosion of three different typical warheads, the blasting warhead, spherical shaped charge warhead and conical shaped charge warhead are numerically simulated by using the finite element simulation software, and the forward shock wave load distribution laws of three different warheads are analyzed. The results shows that the forward shock wave load distribution of the three typical warheads tends to be consistent with the increase of axial distance. The rarefaction wave formed in the front air chamber of the warhead makes the peak pressure of the shock wave around the air chamber less than the peak pressure of the lateral shock wave. At the same axis position, the peak pressure of shock wave of blasting charge is greater than that of shaped charge, and the peak pressure of shock wave of conical shaped charge is greater than that of spherical shaped charge. Under the same charge quantity and explosion height, the damage effect of conical shaped charge on the target plate is better than that of spherical shaped charge.

articleTitle: Spherical-GMM: A Rotation and Scale Invariant Method for Point Cloud Classification
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: 3D Point Cloud data structure has been widely used in a number of industries such as auto-driving, general surveying system and object reconstruction. The classification task with point cloud data is especially helpful in radar or scanning-based conditions which require auto recognition of objects. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) has become the top choice for learning problems involving 2D planar images. However, CNN usually does not preserve in-variance for rotation nor scaling. In this paper, we introduce a new method which implements Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) to project point cloud features onto the surfaces of a varied matrix of enclosing spheres and uses Spherical CNNs which contain spherical cross-correlation that is both expressive and rotation-invariant. The method achieves 82.09% accuracy in random rotations and 86.70% in static conditions while trained in static 3D MNIST dataset.

articleTitle: Motion Imagery Classification Based on the Combination of CSP and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a method combing the common spatial pattern (CSP) with deep learning for EEG feature extraction and recognition in brain-computer interface (BCI) applications. The feature matrix is obtained by CSP spatial transformation on the basis of the original EEG signal processed by time domain filtering. Then deep learning is applied to extract and classify the features from the feature matrix. This work was experimentally tested on the dataset 2b of BCI Competition IV and achieved an accuracy of 85.04%. The method in this paper compares favourably with deep learning models for classification of the original data and with the classification results of the original data after time domain filtering only. This study integrates the temporal and spatial information of the data to be characterised, and uses deep learning to optimise the features again, providing a new idea for the feature extraction problem of EEG.

articleTitle: Influence and effect of fitness applet on college students' physical health
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: The research is to determine the correlation between college student sports lifestyle and fitness-health. The methods are mathematical statistics of experimental method percentile analysis, and multi-level rank correlation test methods were used to develop a statistic analysis. A significantly positive correlation exists between college students' use of mobile sports APP to exercise and fitness-health (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{P} < 0.01$</tex>). The results show that the higher the evaluation rank is, the higher the fitness-health test scores are. Constructing the evaluation standards of college student use mobile sports APP to exercise is aimed to better understand current situation of the college student sports lifestyle; positive correlation exists between college student sports lifestyle and physique health; college student sports lifestyle has a dramatic influence and great promotion on students' body shape, physiology health, qualities, psychology health and social adaptation.

articleTitle: CUDA acceleration for solving three-dimension time-dependent parabolic partial differential equation
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a detailed description of programming the time-dependent three-dimensional (3D) parabolic partial differential equation on graphics processing units (GPU). To this end, we frame the problem as the progression stencil on a 3D surface. We adopt finite-different time-domain (FDTD) method to obtain the stencil corresponding to the partial differential equation, which is then programmed according to CUDA (compute unified device architecture) parallel programming model using GPU's shared memory. Experimental results show that comparing with the program that runs on a single CPU (central processing unit), the current GPU version can greatly reduce the run time so as to improve the performance, accelerate the computation speed, and enable the large-scale simulation.

articleTitle: Requirements and Architecture Design of Human Computer Interaction System for Manned Spacecraft Based on Deep Space Exploration Mission
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Based on the function and application of human-computer interaction system of manned spacecraft, this paper analyzes its requirements in deep space exploration mission, predicts the development trend of human-computer interaction system in future manned deep space exploration mission, puts forward the conceptual model and architecture design of human-computer interaction system based on deep space exploration mission, and discusses the implementation approach.

articleTitle: The Use of Analogical Reasoning in Similar Judicial Cases Retrieval System
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: At present, the common technology adopted by legal artificial intelligence lacks special attention to the legal professional's activity scenes, and the trial judicial cases retrieval system has some problems such as inaccurate push results and unclear algorithm design. Analogical reasoning is not only a legal method of referring to precedents, but also a basic algorithm of artificial intelligence; Constructing the algorithm framework of a cases retrieval system based on analogical reasoning is helpful to improve the practical effect of cases retrieval, “positive affirmation” algorithm module, the “reverse exclusion” module and “Probabilistic corrections” module are the main architecture, Analogical reasoning breaks through its own limitations in the combination of artificial intelligence technology and promotes the application of newly developing technologies in the judicial field.

articleTitle: Second-sliding mode adaptive active flux control for Interior Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: A stator active flux second-order sliding mode adaptive observer is proposed for interior permanent magnet synchronous motor (IPMSM) sensorless control systems to improve dynamic performance and avoid chattering in traditional sliding mode observer. Utilizing Super-twisting Algorithm (STA), the proposed observer is presented defining the stator current error and its estimations as state variables. In the proposed observer, the accurate active flux estimation fast converged in finite time can be obtained, and then the rotor information is obtained. The system possesses strong robustness and the motor realizes stability performance due to existence of active flux estimation and the rotor information. The simulation results verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Image Quality Improve by Super Resolution Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In this research, we analyze the methods to improve the quality of the pictures. Machine learning technique is used to achieve the effect of converting low-pixeled pictures into high pixeled ones. It is convenient and can be used in many circumstances, such as engineering projects and medical surveys. This study uses the SRGAN to train the model, which has the generator network and the discriminator network. The generator network is used to generate high-resolution images, and the discriminator network is used to judge the authenticity of the image generated. Our network has trained the network with 8× upscaling factors and eventually obtains predominant achievement for dealing with detailed textures like trees, cars, and animal fur. Our network can recover low-quality pictures perpetual satisfying, and the loss of this model is low. Our research provides model-based strategic support for image quality improvement and gets a good picture resolution increase in the tests.

articleTitle: Research on Feature Extraction and Classification Measurement of Surface Electromyography for Control of Prosthetic Hand
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Surface electromyography(sEMG) is the electrical signal generated during muscle contraction and is an important basis for detecting muscle activity. When the hand performs different movements, the sEMG produced by the muscles will be different. By detecting the signal, we can recognize the person's movement intent. At present, most myoelectric prosthetic hands use the method of threshold detection of sEMG to control their movement. When the sEMG reaches the threshold, the prosthetic hand will move with a fixed gesture. This method of threshold detection usually implements only one gesture. In order to realize the control of a variety of gestures, it is necessary to classify and process the sEMG. This paper analyzes the feature vectors of the sEMG of healthy subjects, uses different feature vectors to classify the sEMG of four different gestures, and selects three best-performed feature vectors. At the same time, this paper proposes a statistical index that can measure the separability of the category of feature vectors, through which the separability of feature vectors can be directly judged. This paper selects the classifier with the highest recognition accuracy for these three feature vectors through experiments and uses the sEMG of upper limb amputation patients to conduct experiments that prove the applicability of using these three feature vectors for classification. And the effectiveness of the statistical index is also proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Automated classification of retinal optical coherence tomography volumes based on RepVGG: Experimental validation for detection of dry age-related macular degeneration and diabetic macular edema
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: We introduce an algorithm for the automated classification of optical coherence tomography volumes based on the RepVGG artificial neural network. The algorithm is intended for the detection of dry age-related macular degeneration and diabetic macular edema from optical coherence tomography volumes. RepVGG is a simple yet powerful convolutional neural network that we use to classify optical coherence tomography volumes. Optical coherence tomography volumes from dry age-related macular degeneration, diabetic macular edema, and normal samples can be classified. We experimentally evaluated the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm on an optical coherence tomography dataset collected from 45 subjects (15 healthy subjects, 15 patients with dry age-related macular degeneration, and 15 patients with diabetic macular edema). The proposed algorithm correctly classified 73.3% of patients with dry age-related macular degeneration, 93.3% of patients with diabetic macular edema, and 86.7% of normal subjects. This algorithm may contribute to standardizing remote ophthalmic diagnosis of retinal diseases.

articleTitle: Research on Early Fault Diagnosis Method of Rolling Bearing
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In this paper, an early fault diagnosis method of rolling bearing is proposed to solve the problem of weak effective information and difficult fault feature extraction caused by noise pollution and transmission path attenuation of early fault signal of rolling bearing. This method combines the noise reduction performance of variational mode decomposition and the feature enhancement ability of independent component analysis to achieve the purpose of early fault diagnosis of rolling bearing. The proposed method is used to process the noise-containing simulation signal and the early fault measured signal, and the fault information is successfully extracted, which verifies the feasibility and practicability of this method.

articleTitle: Effective Social Relationship-based Routing Strategy in Vessel Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In recent years, the application of vessel networks has become more and more widespread, and the research for the social properties in Vessel Ad Hoc Networks (VANETs) has attracted attention. Existing studies targeting relationships among vessels neither consider enough factors nor take reality into account. This paper fully exploits the vessel-vessel (V-V) and vessel-port (V-P) relationships and propose metrics Closeness (or simply C) and Social Distance (SD) to depict their strength. We also design a Closeness-based Routing strategy (CR) to achieve efficient message transmissions. By applying a real data set of vessel trajectories, a simulation experiment is conducted to evaluate the performance of routing we design. The results show that CR reaches higher message delivery ratio and lower cost compared with other existing routing methods.

articleTitle: Complex Network Variability Analysis with Impact of Major Events on Aviation Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Global aviation data has complex, large and fast-updated characteristics which it's not suitable for directly building complex networks. It's challenging to assess the stability of a particular airport by analyzing the aviation network. This paper presents Complex Network Variability Analysis (CNVA) to analyze the stability of the nodes in the aviation network, which face to international incidents such as COVID-19. Firstly, CNVA cleans the data with missing information to solve the problem of data redundancy. We compress flights' data which have same origin and destination and count their number. Then, CNVA calculates all nodes' harmonic closeness centrality, betweenness centrality and eigen centrality of the data in each month, which can analyze the significance features of each months' network. Next, we calculate the centrality's average rate of variety, and we use these data's average of the absolute values as parameter value. The parameters are used to construct a vector function which called V function. HCC, BC and EC are the variables of V function. Finally, we evaluate whether a node has a large change during COVID-19 period, we calculate the difference between the average change rate of the node's V value and the average change rate of the global function V, and we evaluate its size. To verify the credibility of CNVA, we search for nodes with a higher degree of centrality for CNVA method verification. The results show that the node's V constant value greater than V function constant which have better fluctuations when they face to COVID-19. Our analysis illustrates that CNVA can better assess the stability of airports in response to major incidents when the raw data sources are sufficient.

articleTitle: Research and analysis of wing assembly tracking registration method based on Hololens2
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In the intelligent auxiliary assembly system based on mixed reality technology, three-dimensional tracking registration technology is one of its core technologies. At the same time, this technology is also the basis for the stable operation of the intelligent auxiliary assembly system. When mixed reality technology is applied to the production and assembly of wings, it is accurate and rapid. The tracking registration technology is one of the important links of the system, because it often means the accuracy and stability of the virtual information superimposed on the real environment. Based on the Hololens2 equipment, this paper develops a virtual and real combination auxiliary wing assembly system on the unity3D virtual simulation platform. Through the simulation of the real assembly environment, It compares the performance effects of today's mainstream tracking registration technology in the wing assembly process, and finds out a tracking and registration technology most suitable for the wing assembly process, thereby further improving the assembly efficiency and learning efficiency of assembly operators and trainers.

articleTitle: Mining and analysis of messages on the government affairs platform
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: The online political inquiry platform has gradually become an important channel for the government to understand public opinion, but the manual processing method has problems such as large workload, low efficiency, and high error rate. In order to solve this problem, an improved Term Frequency–Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) algorithm text classification model is proposed. First, the dictionary is reconstructed by removing high-frequency and low-discrimination terms, and new features are obtained by introducing multiple feature factors and entropy factors. Weight calculation formula, experimental data show that this model effectively solves the problem of low keyword extraction accuracy caused by the lack of attention to words with high similarity in traditional algorithms, and has good advantages in the classification of government affairs platform message text and applicability.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Metal Particle Scattering Driven by Explosive Based on ANSYS/LS-DYNA
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In order to avoid the damage of ammunition to irrelevant personnel in modern war, low collateral damage has been more and more important in urban combat. This paper studied the key problems in the design of a controllable warhead with low collateral damage. In the design of a controlled warhead with low collateral damage, numerical simulation of explosive driven metal particle scattering was carried out based on ANSYS/LS-DYNA, and the acceleration process of explosive driven metal particles was obtained, and the curves of different mass metal particles with time were given. In addition, the scattering law of the same mass explosive of driving different mass metal particles was also summarized. The above research can provide theoretical basis for the design of a controllable warhead with low collateral damage.

articleTitle: A meta rule based Graph Grammar formalism for Spatial Graph
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: To increase the flexibility of graph grammar, this paper proposes a new graph grammar formalism named mcCGG for the specification of spatial graphs. Different from traditional graph grammars, mcCGG defines the productions hierarchically by introducing meta productions into the formalism, where meta productions are the prototypes of common productions and have higher abstract level. In mcCGG, the workflow of graph grammar is performed by the fixed productions, which could be generated from meta productions under the guidance of given assertions. Moreover, an example of graph drawing is given to illustrate the application of mcCGG, where a set of programming flowcharts could be generated by the hierarchical productions in a flexible yet uniform layout.

articleTitle: Research on Visual Assembly Design Flow of a Certain Type of Gun Automatic Ammunition Feeder
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: With the continuous application of 3DMPS (3D Machining Process System) in manufacturing enterprises, parts assembly assisted by traditional 2D CAD drawings has been unable to meet the requirements of product quality and production cycle of enterprises. In this paper, a new method of 3D visual assembly procedure is proposed, through the 3D model of the workpiece, the generation of the assembly path, the visual design of the assembly process and the output of 3D ASSEMBLY 3D PDF (or AVI video). The whole assembly process of gun automatic ammunition feeder is realized by visual path output and three-dimensional model assembly demonstration modules. This method can effectively improve the simplification of product assembly process, more intuitive display of product assembly operations for operators, improve the efficiency and accuracy of the feeding machine assembly, and provide a feasible and effective support for enterprises to establish a modern production line.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction and Recognition of Typical Targets by Linear Array LiDAR
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Aiming at solving the problem that the precision of existing algorithms for sparse point cloud image is unsatisfactory, a target recognition algorithm based on the combination of target shape characteristics and LiDAR echo intensity is proposed. By analyzing and processing the linear array scanning data of the target, remove the ground point cloud by using the point cloud elevation information histogram and the adaptive threshold method of the number of point clouds. On this basis, the mathematical morphology algorithm is used to filter the typical nontarget objects. Finally, the algorithm combining the target shape characteristics and echo intensity is used to realize the accurate recognition of the target. The results show that the algorithm is efficient and easy to implement, and has a good recognition effect on sparse point cloud targets.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Upper Limb Comfort Based on Muscle Activation and Joint Angle in Human-Machine Interface
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Objective An upper limb comfort evaluation model based on sports biomechanics was established and its effectiveness was verified. Methods 10 subjects were selected to participate in 11 typical space upper limb tasks under different external loads and operating posture. The effects of muscle range of motion and joint Angle on joint comfort were analyzed, and then the evaluation model of joint and upper limb comfort based on muscle range of motion and joint Angle was established and verified experimentally. Results The influence of muscle range of motion on joint comfort is related to the type of joint but not to the direction of joint force. Unreasonable joint Angle <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(90^{\circ})$</tex> will affect joint comfort; Pearson correlation analysis showed that there was a significant positive correlation between the model evaluation results and subjective comfort (hand rotation: <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$r=0.823,\ p<0.05$</tex>; pull back: <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$r= 0.878,\ p < 0.05$</tex>; lifting: <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$r=0.275,p > 0.05)$</tex> and there was no significant difference between them (hand rotation: <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$t=-1.306, p > 0.05$</tex>; pull back: <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$t=0.654,\ p > 0.05$</tex>; lifting: <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$t=-0.432,\ p > 0.05)$</tex> Conclusion The upper limb comfort evaluation model based on motion biomechanics can evaluate the upper limb comfort objectively and systematically.

articleTitle: Weak Pulse Signal Detecting under Chaotic Noise with Wavelet Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In this paper, wavelet neural network is used to detect the weak pulse signal in the chaotic noise background. The detection process is as follows: Firstly, the observed signal is reconstructed; Then the wavelet neural network is used for one-step prediction to get the signal error; Finally, we apply the dynamic detection method proposed in this paper to deal with the signal error. In order to show the detection effect, we designed three simulation experiments. The data used in the three experiments is composed of the chaotic signal obtained by solving the Lorentz equation plus white noise and the target signal. Three simulation experiments show that the detection effect of this model is very good when the SNR is greater than −153.66038 dB; We use the model in this paper to detect whether there is a weak pulse signal, and get that ACC and Sensitivity are 1, while other models are less than 1.

articleTitle: Research on Kansei Engineering Features of Automobile Dashboard of Young Group Based on Eye Movement Test
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: This research took the young as the testing objects, applied the theoretical knowledge of Kansei Engineering to collect and filter the vocabulary set that can reflect young people's automobile aesthetics based on the literature method, expert interviews and questionnaire surveys. Different styles of dashboards had been chosen and were tested with Tobii Pro Glasses2. In order to guide the design practice, the thesis demonstrated the matching between the kansei semantics and design features of the automobile dashboard of the young group, and obtained the design tendency of the young towards automobile dashboard interface in view of experiments.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Mathematical Methods in Image Denoising Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In the process of acquisition, compression, transmission and storage, digital images are often interfered by imaging equipment and the external environment, resulting in image distortion. Image denoising aims to truly reconstruct the image from the observation data contaminated by noise to provide more accurate and reliable information for the subsequent processing of the image. Therefore, image noise reduction is the most basic and most important link in the field of image processing research. In the past decade or so, the application of theories and methods of partial differential equations (PDEs) in various fields of image processing has attracted more and more attention. This article researches and analyzes the image processing methods based on partial differential equations. First, it introduces the research background of this article, the development history, principles of partial differential equations and the status quo of image processing; then, it summarizes and analyzes the application of partial differential equations to images Classical model of denoising. Through the analysis of the classic model, it can be known that the image noise reduction algorithm based on partial differential equations can be based on the structural characteristics of the image. This method adopts a corresponding smoothing strategy, and it can achieve satisfactory image denoising effects.

articleTitle: Positioning assembly parts based on improved TDOA algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Aiming at solving the problem of positioning accuracy in UWB technology, an improved TDOA algorithm is proposed to solve the problem of initial time synchronization between base stations and realize the accurate positioning of UWB. First, it introduces how the improved TDOA algorithm solves the problem of clock synchronization, and the mathematical model of the TDOA algorithm is established. The experimental data verifies that the accuracy of the improved algorithm in actual measurement has been improved. Finally, combined with the advantages of the TDOA algorithm of the ultra-wideband positioning system in the positioning technology, more accurate parts position information can be obtained by improving the TDOA algorithm and mathematical formula derivation. A more accurate positioning of the positioning target was achieved, which proved the feasibility of the theory.

articleTitle: Study on Wing Intelligent Assembly Sequence Planning Based on Catia
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: For the traditional wing assembly inefficiency is easy to error, difficult to supervise and other problems. This paper studies the problem of visualization of the wing assembly system. First, Catia modeling technology was combined with Unity3D technology to construct the virtual assembly parts and workshop. Second, based on UWB wireless positioning technology, the physical assembly workshop assembly parts for real-time positioning monitoring, and the real-time data transmission is uploaded to the virtual visual operation monitoring system platform client for virtual workshop state update. Finally, the part assembly order is predicted based on optimizing the genetic algorithm and using the Markov model prediction to select a better part assembly order for assembly. The comparison of the two methods shows that the optimized prediction model based on genetic algorithm can improve the efficiency of intelligent assembly, reduce the error rate, and be more conducive to regulation and promotion

articleTitle: Research on Test Score Entry App Based on DL
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Although the informatization of university educational administration system improves the efficiency of student information management to a great extent, the examination scores of students still need to be manually entered into the educational administration system by teachers, and the whole process is cumbersome. In order to solve this problem, this paper designs and implements a test score entry app based on deep learning principle and image processing technology. The app aims to help college teachers enter students' test scores, improve the speed and accuracy of score entry, and further realize the informatization of college students' information management.

articleTitle: Human action recognition based on convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In the field of human action recognition, a good action classification algorithm has always been the key to measure the accuracy of action recognition. Since the trajectory of human targets is often complex, the recognition of RGB color images is restricted by many influencing factors, such as light intensity, complex background and angle. In this paper, kinect equipment is used to collect depth image data, and the image is generated into bone data. The Alexnet model in convolutional neural network is used to train and classify the data, which effectively improves the accuracy of action recognition.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Human-machine Interaction (HMI) Availability Assessment System
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In response to the problems in the implementation process of human-machine interaction (hereafter referred to HMI) availability assessment, such as heavy workload of manual data entry, easy occurrence of mistakes, lack of standardized management in the testing process and difficulty in obtaining comprehensive quantitative assessment results, this paper studies a HMI availability assessment system, which realizes the execution and management of the whole-process evaluation procedure including index system maintenance, availability test creation, test data collection and processing and assessment result display and provides a professional tool for HMI availability assessment.

articleTitle: Importance of compliant joints in below-knee exoskeletons for improving walking
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: This paper evaluated an exoskeleton with compliant joints containing a toe joint. The ankle and toe joints were driven by two series elastic of actuators that can provide maximal push-off power. Firstly, the Human walking experiments were conducted for exploring the effects of the toe joint on providing power and keeping the gait balanced. Secondly, based on a theoretical model and computations, a compliant exoskeleton with a toe joint was designed for those whose ankle is not powerful enough for walking. Because of the impedance control, the exoskeleton was controlled to either follow or guide a person. Finally, an experiment with one person whose ankle could not provide enough power for supporting walking was conducted, and the results validated the effectiveness of the toe joint containing compliant actuators during walking.

articleTitle: Improved 3D Human Pose Real-time Estimation based on Monocular Video
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Aiming at the ambiguity of real-time estimation of human posture depth of criminal behavior in the field of monocular visual surveillance, an improved 3D human posture real-time estimation method based on video is proposed. Firstly, the 2D joint point coordinates of each frame of characters in unmarked video are detected and used as the input of constrained generation countermeasure network to generate 3D human posture with human joint constraints, Combined with the one-dimensional motion information back projected onto the two-dimensional plane, the result is consistent with the corresponding input in the same frame. The information combination method used in this method can not only rely on a small amount of data to obtain a more ideal accuracy, but also correct and optimize the character motion in the three-dimensional space. At the same time, the constrained generation confrontation network is used to solve the ambiguous motion posture, The experimental results on human 3.6m public data set and self collected criminal behavior video set show the accuracy and practical applicability of this method, and the comparison results are also better than the previous benchmark algorithms.

articleTitle: Pedestrian Anomaly Detection Method using Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: It is significant that video surveillance system is adopted for the city security. For the detection of pedestrian anomaly behavior, an autoencoder-based detection model was trained using image sequences with few or no anomalous events in the framework of unsupervised learning. Deep neural networks constructed from convolution autoencoders process video frames in an unsupervised manner for capturing the spatial information of the data. These spatial structures are then combined together to form the data representation. Three-layer convolution long short-term memory model (Long Short Term Memory, LSTM) is adopted for a temporal encoder to learn the encoding spatial structure. Finally, these feature data are scored to determine whether the pedestrian's behavior is normal according to evaluation criteria. The proposed model is trained on various datasets, which demonstrates its effectiveness and robustness.

articleTitle: Psychology of Colour in User Experience/Interaction: ‘Emotional Colour in Visualisation’ Theory in Interaction Design for User Experience: The Design of the Italian Medical Linkage System as an example
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: User experience research methods and user-centred design thinking have become dominant in interaction design. Thus, exploring the migration of user experience methods and theories to interaction design practice has become a common goal for designers and researchers. As one of the bridges between emotional design and visual design for interaction, visual emotional colour theory can become one of the dimensions of design standards in immersive user experience research. Therefore, the use of visual emotional colour theory in user-centred interaction design practice is explored in this study from the perspective of colour psychology, in conjunction with the design of Italian medical linkage system.

articleTitle: Impact of COVID-19 on the World Air Transport Network System
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: As the COVID-19 becomes more prevalent worldwide, many countries take various measures to minimize the spread of infection. Since the main route of transmission of covid-19 is through the air, an analysis of transport, particularly global air traffic nodes, will provide a visual representation of the impact of covid-19 on the worldwide air transport industry. This paper uses publicly available aviation data to model the network and analyze the topology of the world aviation network before and after the COVID-19 outbreak in 2019 and 2020 to analyze the impact of the covid-19 epidemic on the world's aviation industry. First, we successfully visualized the significance of the change in the number of flight routes before and after the outbreak and the different distribution in each region by modeling the worldwide airline traffic network. Then, after a series of analyses and investigations. Second, we collected open-source data showing that the overall number of flights worldwide has been downward following the COVID-19 outbreak.
